title: Loading Potato Barrels by Hoist — Pratt Farm, Lower Brighton
description: Barrels full of potatoes were loaded onto flatbed trucks by a hydraulic arm or barrel hoist with a grapple that wrapped around the barrel rim and lifted it onto the truck, with a hand steadying it. This back-saving device was invented in Presque Isle, Maine, in 1949. Courtesy of Donnie Pratt collection.
